title: A neutron star is about 20 km in diameter but has more mass than the Sun.
purpose: Give a sense of scale and extreme density.
narration: A neutron star packs more mass than our Sun into a sphere just twenty kilometers across. That makes it incredibly dense, with material compressed to densities far beyond anything on Earth.
ssml: <speak>A neutron star packs more mass than our Sun into a sphere just <emphasis level="moderate">twenty</emphasis> kilometers across.<break time="300ms"/>That makes it incredibly dense, with material compressed to densities far beyond anything on Earth.</speak>

claims.text: A neutron star is about 20 km in diameter but has more mass than the Sun.
Neutron stars have extremely high density, compressing matter beyond Earth-normal conditions.
